name: Long campus interview at Wipro with zero pre-placement-talk reference

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I am Rahul, final year CSE at a mid-tier engineering college, looking to start my career in software services with a stable organisation.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your strongest project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I built a Spring Boot inventory service backed by Postgres, deployed on Render. Source is at github.com/me/inventory.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why do you want to join us?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your company has a strong training program and global presence, and I want to build my foundation in a structured environment with mentorship.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a teamwork example.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In our 4-person FYP, I owned the backend while teammates handled frontend and integrations; we coordinated through daily standups and a shared Notion board.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Where do you see yourself in five years?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I plan to become a senior engineer with end-to-end ownership of at least one major module, and I want to mentor junior members the way I hope to be mentored now.
